Avride expands Grubhub and Wonder robot delivery across four US markets

Philadelphia, Hoboken and Arlington County join a wider Jersey City service area, with restaurant and customer opt-in.

PhillyVoice ↗21 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

Expansion beyond the earlier pilot

Avride announced expanded Grubhub and Wonder delivery on October 21 across Philadelphia, Hoboken in New Jersey and Arlington County in Virginia, plus a larger Jersey City area following its earlier pilot. This is separate from Avride’s existing Uber Eats operation in Philadelphia.

Restaurants and customers opt in

Grubhub restaurants can choose robot delivery, while customers must opt in and be within a supported area. The plan includes Wonder food halls and other participating restaurants, with dozens expected to join across the four markets. It does not mean every order will travel by robot.

Fleet size remains undisclosed

Avride has not specified how many robots it will add in Philadelphia. The announcement establishes planned partner and geographic expansion rather than measured delivery-capacity or speed gains. Sharing sidewalks with people remains an important issue as the service grows.
